# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v4.1.0

这个版本动的是**你每天真正在读的那块东西**：事务的「本次行动细则」。

它以前是一整块自由文本——「这次打算怎么做」和「我上次做到哪」写在同一段里。这在只隔一天的时候没问题，但你我都知道真实情况：一个事务放下一周再回来，要先把整段重读一遍，才知道自己停在哪；而这整段里没有任何东西可以被勾掉，于是"这件事还剩什么"只能靠脑子记。v4.1.0 把它拆成两件东西：**一条一条能勾的待办清单**，和**按用途分栏的行动细则**。

## 新增：事务与想法的待办清单

清单回答的是内容维度的问题：**这件事还剩哪几件没做。**

- **三态，且打叉不是删除**：勾选＝完成（记下完成当天）；`✕`＝放弃，**原地保留、随时可恢复**，行尾留下"已放弃 · 日期"；真正的删除在展开的详情里，需要再确认一次。
- **放弃项不扩大分母**：进度读数是「已完成 x/y」，其中 y 只数未放弃的条目——与执行切片的规则一致。所以"这件事剩下的我决定不做了"不会让进度永远停在 3/5。
- **每条都能展开**：写「备注 · 结果」（做到哪一步、结论是什么）、放参考链接、贴图（和细则用同一条图片链路）。
- **「放进今天」**：把某一条补成今天的执行切片；卡片右上角「多选」可以批量放进今天或批量打叉。
- **回车连续添加**；把多行文本一次粘进去，会一条一条生成，不用敲十次回车。
- 待办与切片**互不锁定**：切片仍然只表示"一天投入一份"，做完切片不要求待办勾完，反之亦然。

## 新增：完成事务要先做一次决定

点「标记为完成」（或在状态下拉里选"已完成"）时，如果还有未完成的切片或待办，会先弹出一层确认：把它们逐条列出来，让你选一种处置方式——**全部标为放弃后完成**（切片记已放弃、待办打叉，都保留痕迹可撤销）、**保留为未完成收尾，直接完成**（只在当前状态里留一条遗留说明）、或者**记录原因后完成**（写一句为什么现在结束）。没有任何未完成项时，直接完成，不多一步。

这里刻意**没有**做成硬拦截。原因是实现时才想清楚的一条规则：切片一旦记为"错过"或"放弃"，就永远不会再变成"完成"，所以硬拦截会让任何放弃过切片的事务**永远无法完成、也无法放弃，只剩删除一条路**。所以规则是"不能静默完成"，而不是"不能完成"。

## 变更：「本次行动细则」结构化为字段

原来的一整块长文变成按用途分的字段，顺序就是复访时的阅读顺序：

- **当前状态**：第一眼看的地方，分两行——**自动行**给出本来就知道的事实（切片 3/5 · 待办 2/5 · 最近更新 3 天前 · 离截止 9 天），**手写行**由你写"上次做到 / 卡在哪"。空着的时候它会明说「写一句『上次做到 / 卡在哪』」，而不是假装没这回事。
- **背景与约束**：为什么有这件事、有哪些限制；
- **Prompt**：发给 AI 的提示词，一键复制；
- **阶段性成果**：一条一条，每条自带日期，可增删改，最新在上；
- **行动指导与想法**：打算怎么做；
- **完成定义**（默认折叠）：怎么算做完；
- **下一步行动**：仍然是原来的独立字段，只是作为卡片最后一张字段卡渲染——**"下一步"在全页只写一次**。

每个字段都能在大编辑窗口里写长文、贴图、渲染 Markdown；阅读态**已填字段只显示一行预览**，点开才展开，未填字段只占一行提示。上一版把所有字段都摊开成一个编辑框，读起来像一张表；现在的目标是一条视线读完"我停在哪、接下来做什么"。

## 新增：行动细则模板

把当前细则的结构存成模板（只存字段文字，不含阶段性成果），在任意事务或想法的细则卡「模板」里套用。**套用只填空字段**，已写内容一个字都不会被覆盖，所以它也可以当"补齐缺失字段"用。模板存在插件内部 `action-templates.json`，不绑定具体条目。

## 变更：「任务」类型退役

类型集合里的"任务"一直没有独立语义（它只是项目下的一个可选层级，不接执行切片、不参与今日），实测你自己的工作区里也是 0 条。这个版本把它从新建选项、类型下拉、角色图例和上级候选里去掉，层级简化为**长期领域 → 项目 → 事务／想法**。万一存在存量任务，它仍会显示为「任务（旧类型）」并可手动改类型——**不会自动改任何条目的类型**。

## 修复

- **待办清单曾经整个不渲染**：重构详情面板时 `<TodoListCard>` 标签被误删，而 import 与逻辑都还在，于是编译通过、类型检查通过、界面上却永远看不到待办清单。已恢复，并补了三条回归测试盯住它（位置在行动细则之前、勾选即时保存、想法有而项目没有）。
- **保存模板曾静默失败**：模板名原先用 `window.prompt` 询问，而 Electron 渲染进程不支持它（返回 null），配合代码里的 `if (name === null) return;`，表现就是"点了没反应"。改为面板内输入框，并在套用时给出反馈（补了几个字段，或"没有可填空字段"）。
- 图片清理与图库体检的扫描范围扩展到细则全部字段、阶段性成果与待办备注，并按路径去重——否则"待办里贴的图"既不会进清理范围，也会在确认列表里出现重复项。

## 数据安全

- 旧的 `currentAction` 长文**不会丢**：解析时一次性迁移进「行动指导与想法」，并在当前状态里留一行「（旧版细则已迁移）」。迁移幂等、不覆盖已写内容，原字段继续保留为兼容文本（图片清理、图库体检、缺字段提示仍读它）。
- 所有写入仍走原来的链路：串行队列、写入前轮换备份、写入后重新读取并完整比对，主文件损坏时从修订号最高的有效备份恢复。
- 升级后第一次打开某条事务，你会看到当前状态里的迁移提示——直接编辑它就能清掉。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v4.1.0

This release reworks **the block you actually read every day**: a transaction's Current Action Details.

It used to be one free-form text block — "how I plan to do this" and "where I stopped last time" written into the same paragraph. That is fine across a single day, but the real situation is this: leave a transaction alone for a week, come back, and you have to re-read the whole thing before you know where you were. Nothing inside it can be ticked off either, so "what is left" lives only in your head. v4.1.0 splits it into two things: **a to-do list you can tick**, and **action details split by purpose**.

## New: a to-do list on Transactions and Ideas

The list answers the item-level question: **what is still left to do.**

- **Three states, and crossing out is not deleting**: check = done (the completion date is recorded); `✕` = dropped, **kept in place and restorable at any time**, leaving "dropped · date" on the row. Real deletion lives inside the expanded row and asks once more.
- **Dropped items do not enlarge the denominator**: progress reads "done x/y" where y counts only items that were not dropped — the same rule execution slices use. Deciding not to do the rest never freezes progress at 3/5.
- **Every row expands**: notes/results ("how far did I get, what was the conclusion"), reference links, and images, sharing the exact image pipeline the details use.
- **"Put into today"** turns one item into today's execution slice; **Multi-select** on the card header drops or schedules several at once.
- **Enter adds continuously**; pasting several lines creates several items in one go, instead of ten presses of Enter.
- To-dos and slices **never lock each other**: a slice still means "one day of investment", and finishing slices does not require finishing the list, or the other way round.

## New: finishing a transaction asks for a decision first

Marking a transaction complete (or choosing the completed status) with unfinished slices or to-dos now opens a confirmation layer that lists them and asks you to choose: **drop everything and complete** (slices become abandoned, to-dos get crossed out, all reversible), **keep them as outstanding and complete anyway** (one leftover note is written into Current State), or **record why you are closing it now**. With nothing unfinished it completes directly, with no extra step.

This is deliberately **not** a hard block. The rule only became clear while implementing it: a slice marked missed or abandoned can never become completed again, so a hard block would make any transaction that ever dropped a slice **impossible to finish and impossible to abandon — leaving deletion as the only way out**. So the rule is "cannot complete silently", not "cannot complete".

## Changed: Current Action Details is now structured fields

The single block became fields ordered the way you read on return:

- **Current State**: the first thing to read, in two lines — an **automatic** line with facts the app already knows (slices 3/5 · to-dos 2/5 · last update 3 days ago · 9 days to the deadline) and a **hand-written** line for "where I stopped / what blocks me". When empty it says so plainly instead of pretending the field does not exist.
- **Background & constraints**: why this exists and what limits apply.
- **Prompt**: the prompt you send to an AI, copyable with one click.
- **Staged results**: one entry per line, each dated, newest first.
- **Guidance & ideas**: how you intend to do it.
- **Definition of done** (collapsed by default).
- **Next Action**: still the same separate field, rendered as the last field card — so "what is next" is written **exactly once** on the page.

Every field supports long-form editing with images and Markdown in the large editor window. In reading mode **filled fields show a single preview line** until expanded, and empty ones take a single line. The previous build opened every field into a box and read like a form; the goal now is one line of sight for "where I stopped, what is next".

## New: action detail templates

Save the current structure as a template (field text only, without staged results) and apply it from the Template menu on any Transaction or Idea. Applying **only fills empty fields** and never overwrites what is written, so it doubles as "fill in the missing fields". Templates live in the plugin's own `action-templates.json` and are not tied to any single item.

## Changed: the "task" type is retired

The "task" type never had independent semantics (a selectable level under a project that takes no execution slices and never appears in Today), and it turned out to be 0 items in this workspace. It is gone from creation options, the type select, the role legend and parent candidates; the hierarchy is now **Area → Project → Transaction/Idea**. Any legacy task still renders as "task (legacy type)" and can be re-typed by hand — **no item's type is changed automatically**.

## Fixed

- **The to-do list stopped rendering entirely**: while reworking the details panel the `<TodoListCard>` tag was removed by accident, while its import and logic remained — so the build passed, the type check passed, and the list was simply never visible. Restored, with three regression tests guarding it (sits above the action details, checking saves immediately, Ideas have it and Projects do not).
- **Saving a template failed silently**: the name was asked through `window.prompt`, which the Electron renderer does not support (it returns null), and the `if (name === null) return;` guard turned that into a button that did nothing. It now uses an input inside the panel and reports how many empty fields were filled when applying.
- Image cleanup and the storage checkup now scan every detail field, staged results and to-do notes, de-duplicated by path — otherwise images pasted into a to-do neither entered cleanup nor stayed unique in the confirmation list.

## Tests and verification

- 586 tests pass (4 skipped) across 59 files, including the new `todos`, `action-detail`, `completion`, `action-templates`, `todo-list-card` and `completion-gate` suites.
- `svelte-check`: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- Production build succeeds; `package.zip` is attached to this release.

## Problems found and fixed during development

- **A removed component tag that the compiler cannot see**: the to-do list vanished for exactly this reason — imports and logic intact, markup gone. Regression tests now assert on placement and behaviour, not only on the components that were edited.
- **A browser API the desktop shell does not implement**: `window.prompt` in Electron returns null, and the null guard made the template button a no-op. Panel input replaced it.
- **Duplicated images after structuring**: the legacy compatibility text and the new fields describe the same image, which produced duplicate keys in the cleanup confirmation list. Scanning now de-duplicates by path.
- **Text flush against card borders**: the empty-field hint and expanded long text had no left padding of their own, because the outer container's padding only ever worked for centred content. Each block now carries its own left edge, aligned with the field title.

## Notes and limits

- To-do progress **stays inside the details panel** by design: the tree, the week view and the filters do not show to-do badges.
- The to-do list exists on **Transactions and Ideas only**; Projects and Areas show action details but no list.
- The structured action details are stored in the plugin's own `work-items.json`; the old `currentAction` field is kept as compatible text and is regenerated when details change. Empty details never overwrite it.
- Image scanning now covers every detail field and to-do note, so a picture pasted into a to-do is also counted and cleaned up with the item.
- No new dependencies.

## Download

Download `package.zip` from this release's assets. Do not use GitHub's auto-generated "Source code" archives as a SiYuan plugin package.
